instruction: Stand the red pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Observe and get grasp candidates for the red pen
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")

# Choose a candidate grasping across the short axis (fits open fingers)
valid_candidates = [c for c in candidates if c["fits_open_fingers"]]
# Prefer geometry candidates across short side or contact graspnet
best_cand = max(valid_candidates, key=lambda c: c["score"])

# Grasp the pen
grasp_res = grasp(best_cand)
if not grasp_res["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

# To insert vertically into the pen holder:
# Move gripper well above the holder first
holder_x, holder_y = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
table_z = obs["table_z"]
rim_z = table_z + holder["rim_height"]

carry_to(holder_x, holder_y, height=0.35)

# Reorient gripper so the pen points vertically down.
# When grasped across its width with approach=[0, 0, -1], the pen lies along 'side'.
# Pitching the gripper by 90 deg makes the pen vertical.
# Aligning approach horizontally lets the side/pen point along z:
# For approach along [1, 0, 0] and finger_axis along [0, 1, 0], side = approach x finger_axis = [0, 0, 1].
# Check IK for approaching holder with pen vertical
target_z = rim_z + 0.12
move_gripper(holder_x, holder_y, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="line")

# Lower down into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.08)

# Release the pen into the holder
open_gripper()

# Retreat up and park arm
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()

# Verify task success
check("red_pen", "magenta_holder")
